instructions: Always respond in Vietnamese. TrustBite is a monorepo with a Next.js App Router client, Express native-ESM server, and Flutter mobile app. Use docs/ for Harness intake/traceability rules and trustbite-docs/ for product, UX, API, security, database, QA, compliance, and operations documentation. Prioritize correctness, security, API boundary validation, secret handling, AWS provider isolation, and consistency with both Harness and TrustBite product docs.

rules.rule: Do not hardcode secrets, credentials, tokens, database passwords, AWS bucket names, user IDs, or provider credentials in source files. Use environment files or documented examples only.

Parse and validate unknown input at boundaries before passing it to services or domain logic. This includes HTTP params, query, body, files, env vars, JWT/Cognito claims, DB rows, provider responses, GPS coordinates, and OCR payloads.
Preserve dependency direction: client UI -> API client -> server routes/controllers -> services/domain rules -> database/provider adapters. Client must not import server modules.
If a change alters API shape, auth behavior, data model, AWS/provider behavior, anti-fraud thresholds, trust score behavior, or public UX contracts, require matching docs/story updates.
